name: ask_player
description: Ask the player one short multiple-choice question about their game, then wait for the answer. Give exactly two options, A and B. The cabinet adds C "Something else" (the player says their own answer) and D "Make it now". Ask only about things that change how the game plays or looks and that the request leaves open. Never ask for the player's name, age, school or anything else about them. One question per call. The result is JSON text: {"choice":"A"}, {"choice":"B"}, {"choice":"C","said":"<what the player said>"} or {"choice":"D"}. D means: ask no more questions in this build. Fill the gaps yourself, record each one as an Assumption in the spec, and build.

question.description: Short and kid-friendly; fits one screen line (about 50 characters).

option_b.description: Second answer, a few words, clearly different from A.
